newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Belgian firm to produce fibre optic in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Belgian firm to produce fibre optic in Philippines.

text.p: Belgian firm Eupen Cable Asia Inc is planning to set up a 314.5-million peso plant in the northern Philippines, Board of Investments executive director Marita Jimenez said on Monday.

Jimenez said Eupen is eyeing an industrial estate, south of Manila to put its plant which will have a capacity to produce 160,000 kilometres of optic fibre a year. The products will be exported to Indonesia and Malaysia.
The project will be financed mostly through equity and the loans will come through suppliers' credit.
